map.📚 深度解析：五子棋禁手判断: 📚 Deep dive: Gomoku Forbidden Move Check
map.三三禁手：一子落下同时形成两个活三（两端可延伸成四），判禁手。: Double-three forbidden move: one move that forms two open threes at once (each can be extended to a four) is a forbidden move.
map.四四禁手：一子同时形成两个冲四/活四，判禁手。: Double-four forbidden move: one move that forms two closed fours / open fours at once is a forbidden move.
map.长连禁手：黑棋连成六子及以上（非恰好五连），判禁手负。: Overline forbidden move: black making six in a row or more (not exactly five) is a forbidden move and loses.
map.禁手只限黑棋吗？: Are forbidden moves limited to black?
map.是。黑棋先手有禁手以平衡优势；白棋无禁手，长连（≥6）对白棋算胜。: Yes. Black, moving first, has forbidden moves to balance the advantage; white has none, and an overline (6 or more) counts as a win for white.
map.长连对黑棋算胜吗？: Does an overline count as a win for black?
map.不算。黑棋长连（六子及以上）判禁手负；白棋长连判胜。: No. A black overline (six or more) is a forbidden move and loses; a white overline is a win.
map.落子后同时形成两个「活三」（两端均可延伸成四）才构成；若其一为眠三则不判。: It requires two open threes (each can be extended to a four) formed at once after the move; if one of them is a sleeping three, it is not judged as a forbidden move.
map.五子棋禁手判断（黑方规则，棋盘自动分析）: Gomoku forbidden-move check (black-side rules, automatic board analysis)
map.黑方落子后按横 / 竖 / 撇 / 捺四个方向统计连子数: After black plays, count consecutive black stones along the horizontal, vertical and both diagonal directions
map.恰好五连（=5）= 胜利条件，非禁手: Exactly five in a row (=5) is a win, not a forbidden move
map.长连禁手：任一方向连子数 ≥ 6: Overline forbidden move: six or more in a row in any direction
map.四四禁手：该手同时形成 ≥ 2 个「四」: Double-four forbidden move: the move forms two or more "fours" at once
map.三三禁手：该手同时形成 ≥ 2 个「活三」: Double-three forbidden move: the move forms two or more "open threes" at once
map.「四」：某方向 5 格窗口含 4 黑 1 空，补一子即成恰好五连: "Four": a 5-cell window with 4 black stones and 1 empty cell, where one more stone makes exactly five
map.「活三」：补一子后可形成两端开放的活四: "Open three": one more stone would make an open four with both ends free
map.判定优先级：五连胜利 → 长连 → 四四 → 三三 → 合法着法: Priority: five-in-a-row win → overline → double-four → double-three → legal move
map.输入：15×15 棋盘落子 / 粘贴局面 + 待判点坐标（如 H8）: Input: play on a 15×15 board or paste a position, plus the point to judge (e.g. H8)
map.复杂棋型（假活三、同向多四、边界限制）需对照正式规则与裁判复核: Complex shapes (fake open threes, multiple fours in one direction, edge limits) should be double-checked against the official rules and a referee
map.在 15×15 棋盘上按中国五子棋竞赛规则自动分析：可直接点击棋盘落子，也可粘贴: Automatic analysis on a 15×15 board under the Chinese Gomoku competition rules: click the board to place stones, or paste a 15-line position and name the point to judge. The result is based on run lengths and four / open-three counts in four directions, at most one per direction; complex shapes still deserve a manual check.
map.点击棋盘落子：空→黑→白→空，自动分析最后一手黑棋（黑方禁手规则）。: Click the board to place stones: empty → black → white → empty. The last black stone is analyzed automatically (black forbidden-move rules).
map.粘贴局面（15 行、每行 15 位：0 空 / 1 黑 / 2 白；末行可写 j: Paste a position (15 lines, 15 digits each: 0 empty / 1 black / 2 white; add judge:H8 on a final line)
map.黑棋一手棋同时形成两个\"活三\"，判为禁手，黑方负。: A black move that forms two "open threes" at once is a forbidden move, and black loses.
map.活三：下一手可成活四的三连: Open three: a three-in-a-row that can become an open four with the next stone
map.黑棋一手棋同时形成两个\"四\"（含冲四和活四），判为禁手，黑方负。: A black move that forms two "fours" at once (closed fours or open fours) is a forbidden move, and black loses.
map.黑棋形成六连或以上（长连），判为禁手，黑方负。白棋无此限制。: Black forming six or more in a row (overline) is a forbidden move, and black loses. White has no such limit.
map.禁手仅限制黑方（先手方）。白方无禁手限制，且可利用黑棋禁手取胜（强迫黑棋走禁手）: Forbidden moves apply only to black (the first player). White has no forbidden moves and can win by forcing black into one. Exactly five in a row is a win.
map.在 15×15 棋盘上落子或粘贴局面，工具按横、竖、撇、捺四个方向自动分析黑棋该: Play on a 15×15 board or paste a position; the tool analyzes the move in the horizontal, vertical and both diagonal directions to see whether it is a double-three, double-four or overline forbidden move, and reports the run lengths and reasoning.
map.三三 / 四四 / 长连 / 五连四类判定: Four verdicts: double-three / double-four / overline / five-in-a-row
map.支持粘贴 15 行局面文本 + 指定待判点: Paste a 15-line position and specify the point to judge
map.内置三三、长连、五连三个示例: Built-in double-three, overline and five-in-a-row examples
map.自学与教学时核对禁手判定: Check forbidden-move rulings when learning or teaching
map.复盘对局中争议的一手: Review a disputed move after a game
map.练习利用禁手逼迫黑方: Practice forcing black into forbidden moves
map.棋谱局面批量复核: Batch review of positions from game records
map.五连与长连：直接按该落点在四个方向的连续黑子数判断；恰好 5 为胜，≥ 6 为长: Five and overline: judged directly from the run length in four directions; exactly 5 wins, 6 or more is an overline forbidden move.
map.四四禁手：逐方向检测「5 格窗口含 4 黑 1 空、补一子即成恰好五连」的四，两: Double-four: each direction is checked for a "four" (a 5-cell window with 4 black and 1 empty); if two or more directions qualify, it is forbidden.
map.三三禁手：逐方向检测「补一子后可形成两端开放的活四」的活三，两个及以上方向成立即: Double-three: each direction is checked for an open three (one more stone makes an open four); if two or more directions qualify, it is forbidden.
map.每个方向最多计 1 个，避免同一方向的多个窗口重复计数；该点已有黑子时按「查看该: At most one count per direction to avoid double-counting windows in the same line; if the point already holds a black stone, that stone is analyzed instead of simulating a new move.
map.棋盘上 F8、G8、H6、H7 已有黑子，待判点 H8。落下后横向形成 F8-G: With black stones on F8, G8, H6 and H7 and the point to judge at H8: playing H8 makes F8-G8-H8 horizontally and H6-H7-H8 vertically. Each line can be extended by one stone into an open four with both ends free, so both directions count one open three — two in total, a double-three forbidden move and black loses. If one line could only become a closed four (one end blocked), it would not count and the verdict could become a legal move.
map.共 15 行、每行 15 位：0=空、1=黑、2=白，行序从上到下；可另起一行写: 15 lines, 15 digits each: 0=empty, 1=black, 2=white, rows from top to bottom; add a separate line such as judge:H8 to name the point to judge. For example, if the 8th line from the top is 000001100000000, F8 and G8 hold black stones. Click "Load position and analyze" to render the board and get the verdict.
